title: Q-RLEDGER-VERIFY: every seed citation of the Replication Ledger resolves at Crossref
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the tenant repository's first CI run, then weekly with the beat
**Done check:** grep:instances/replication-ledger/worker/data/verified.json::"failed": 0,
**Status:** closed

The 25 seed findings and 6 replication projects cite 62 DOIs written from the published record. The session that wrote them had no route to Crossref (the egress proxy refused api.crossref.org, doi.org and Europe PMC; the fetch proxy refused the batch URLs), so the DOIs are not yet machine-checked. `cli.mjs verify --record` resolves each DOI and compares title and year; any mismatch is fixed in `worker/data/findings.json` from the registry record, never by loosening the check.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `instances/replication-ledger/worker/data/verified.json` (written by `node worker/cli.mjs verify --record`, run in the tenant repository's CI once it exists) records `"failed": 0`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T21:43:10Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
